title: East Bengaluru package: 500-D twice as often, 304-K removed, tech-park feeder added
description: The PRD §73 demonstration: the three Phase 4 scenarios applied together. Modify frequencies: 500-D (route 1066) on the Outer Ring Road runs twice as often. Remove overlapping service: 304-K (routes 2255 and 2256) duplicates the Purple Line between Hope Farm and KR Pura. Introduce a corridor: a 10-min feeder from Kundalahalli metro to the ORR tech parks at 20 km/h (Assumed). Each change is documented in its own scenario file.
expected_change: Gains along the ORR (Silk Board to Hebbal) and near the feeder stops between Kundalahalli and Bellandur; losses along Whitefield Main Road away from Purple Line stations. Each effect is small city-wide, as in the separate runs.
